svg.title: Petals Beyond Signed Radius
svg.desc: Warp 5.4 is six times the normal maximum. Signed radial harmonics reverse through the origin repeatedly; twelve disagreeing cusp families intersect as a thin monochrome tangle with translucent interiors. Native toolbar flow: normal spline bristles → layered cusp combs, with a luminance-preserving monochrome palette.
